slug: 2026-03-01 Rising Repression Meets Global Resistance Internet Shutdowns in 2025

facts.fact: Access Now (#KeepItOn) reports a five-day nationwide internet blackout in Tanzania during the disputed 29 October 2025 election; the document does not name who ordered it, and gives no end date beyond the five days.
Access Now (#KeepItOn) counts 8 internet shutdowns in Tanzania in 2025, the highest of any African country in its report, of which the document describes only the election-time blackout.

note: Document also says the ACHPR condemned Tanzania's shutdown and that satellite (Starlink) orders occurred in Tanzania, undated and without detail; no fact taken.
